summary: This note describes A Distinguished Member of the Humane Society, an 1831 oil on canvas by English painter Sir Edwin Henry Landseer showing a Newfoundland dog. The painting was damaged in a flood while on loan to the Tate Gallery in 1928. It was restored in 2009 and returned to public view for the first time in 50 years.
one_line: An 1831 Edwin Landseer oil painting of a Newfoundland dog, damaged by a 1928 flood and restored in 2009.
